entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We will not be able to go further[n]unless we can defeat that Shadow.[n]Let us eliminate it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're participants, dammit! Get outta[n]the way!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But I don't believe there is any other[n]way through...
